notes: Only eight turns actually used: female/male left/right 90/180. Walk start/stop are excluded.
FBX files and large world-sample JSON are external build inputs/outputs, not repository assets.
Preserve the copyright and permission notices above with redistributed source or derived motion data.
World samples include animated Armature motion. Separate use_anim=False import is an FBX static reference, not an asserted canonical bind pose.
Retarget using the existing pinned Three/UPF vendor and saved current exhibition rigs; matching bone names alone does not establish bind compatibility.
